title: Add README guide for forcing 120 FPS in Project SEKAI via adb
body:
This updates the README with a concise, copy-pasteable workflow for resolving FPS cap issues in Project SEKAI using adb. It documents package discovery, per-package 120 FPS game mode settings, and device-side refresh/performance overrides.

- **Problem coverage**
  - Adds a practical fix path for both global and JP package variants.
  - Includes fallback device-level commands when app-level FPS settings are insufficient.

- **README guide additions**
  - Package discovery command:
    - `adb shell pm list packages -3 | grep sega` (with note to adjust grep term if needed)
  - 120 FPS game mode commands:
    - `com.sega.ColorfulStage.en` (global)
    - `com.sega.pjsekai` (JP)
  - Manual refresh-rate lock commands:
    - `min_refresh_rate`
    - `peak_refresh_rate`
  - Optional fixed performance mode toggle.

- **Example snippet**
```bash
adb shell pm list packages -3 | grep sega
adb shell cmd game set --fps 120 --mode 2 com.sega.ColorfulStage.en
adb shell cmd game set --fps 120 --mode 2 com.sega.pjsekai
adb shell settings put system min_refresh_rate 120.0
adb shell settings put system peak_refresh_rate 120.0
adb shell cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true
```

> adb shell cmd game set --fps 120 --mode 2 com.sega.pjsekai # jp version
> 
> using this command to search/grep for the needed game package via adb:
> adb shell pm list packages -3 | grep sega # change to another id if needed
> 
> use these commands to manually "lock" the refreshrate
> adb shell settings put system min_refresh_rate 120.0 # change this value
> adb shell settings put system peak_refresh_rate 120.0 # this also
> 
> or enable fixed performance mode:
> adb shell cmd power set-fixed-performance-mode-enabled true
